title: A Day at the Museum
setting: A bright art museum with large white walls.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi, a tall young man with short black hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Kofi and Hana visit the art museum today.
sentences.zh: 科菲和哈娜今天去参观美术馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a tall young man with short black hair and a green shirt and Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress walk up the steps of a big art museum.

sentences.en: Hana is an artist, and she paints every day.
sentences.zh: 哈娜是一位画家，她每天都画画。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress paints on a canvas with a brush and a colour palette.

sentences.en: Kofi is a tall actor with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 科菲是一个个子很高、笑容灿烂的演员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a tall young man with short black hair and a green shirt smiles widely in a theatre costume on a small stage.

sentences.en: One painting shows a band with a guitar.
sentences.zh: 有一幅画画的是一支有吉他手的乐队。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a tall young man with short black hair and a green shirt and Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress look at a large painting of a band with a guitar player on a museum wall.

sentences.en: Next to it, a man plays piano music.
sentences.zh: 在它旁边，一个男人在弹钢琴曲。
sentences.scene_prompt: A man plays a grand piano in a bright museum hall next to paintings.

sentences.en: Kofi also takes a photograph of the piano player.
sentences.zh: 科菲还给弹钢琴的人拍了一张照片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a tall young man with short black hair and a green shirt holds up a camera toward a man at a grand piano.

sentences.en: Hana draws a picture in her small book.
sentences.zh: 哈娜在她的小本子上画了一幅画。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress sits on a museum bench and sketches the piano player in a small sketchbook.

sentences.en: Art is Hana's reason to wake up happy.
sentences.zh: 艺术是哈娜每天快乐醒来的理由。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress wakes up smiling in a bedroom full of her own paintings.
